anchors.paper_title: Examining perceptual grouping on stages of processing in visual working memory: an ERP study
anchors.reason: The candidate paper title ('Examining perceptual grouping on stages of processing in visual working memory: an ERP study') exactly matches the dataset's topic and authors, indicating it describes the data release.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 71 channels (64 scalp, 3 EOG, 2 mastoid, 1 CMS/DRL reference) at a sampling rate of 512 Hz. Subjects performed a bilateral change-detection task with memory arrays containing 2-3 colored squares in one visual hemifield, followed by a maintenance period and a single-item probe for change detection. Experimental conditions manipulated array composition (unrepeated vs. repeated colors) and spatial proximity of repeated items. Offline preprocessing included re-referencing to average mastoids, ICA-based artifact removal, and 0.1 Hz high-pass filtering. ERP components were measured in specific time windows relative to stimulus and probe onsets.
